records.label: anthro canine lineage anatomy
records.visual_function: Propose a readable canid muzzle, ear, pad, and tail relationship for an upright subject, leaving build, coat length, markings, and personal traits to the author's declaration.
records.prompt: Anthropomorphic canine lineage (dog, wolf, fox, jackal, coyote): full-body fur with a dense neck ruff, upright triangular canine ears, a long tapered muzzle with a broad nose, paw pads on both hands and feet, a keen sense of smell, and a large fluffy tail. Draw tail motion as an exaggerated emotion amplifier: a big fast wag for joy and high drive, a small hesitant sway for uncertain expectation.
invariants: the muzzle, nose, and triangular ear relationship reads as one canid head structure
paw pads appear on both the hand and the foot surfaces wherever those surfaces show
the tail reads as one continuous mass with the surrounding coat
misreadings_to_avoid: a feline short muzzle and flat nose on a canid head
a human face wearing decorative canine ears
a tail drawn as a separate accessory instead of continuous coat

search_terms.phrase: dog wolf fox jackal coyote anthro anatomy
canine muzzle ruff and paw pads
